name: workflows-mcp-server
description: Store, query, and create YAML workflow playbooks for LLM agents via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

WORKFLOWS_DIR.title: Workflow directory
WORKFLOWS_DIR.description: Absolute path to your workflow library. Leave blank to use ./workflows-yaml.

GLOBAL_INSTRUCTIONS_PATH.title: Global instructions path
GLOBAL_INSTRUCTIONS_PATH.description: Path to the global instructions markdown file. Leave blank to derive it from the workflow directory.

WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_MS.title: Watcher debounce
WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_MS.description: Milliseconds to debounce filesystem changes. Leave blank to use 500.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum RFC 5424 log level: debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, or emerg. Leave blank to use info.
